articleTitle: Software Complex for Modelling Routing in Heterogeneous Model of Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern communication technologies form the foundation for interactions between various objects on the Internet of Things. An autonomous mobile complex is equipped with sensors to assess the environment and make management decisions based on the information obtained. To ensure efficient data transmission from the autonomous mobile device to the base station, modern methods of data processing and transmission should be used. Intelligent methods can be employed to accelerate data transmission when routing data. This paper presents a software complex designed to simulate a heterogeneous model for a wireless sensor network (HWSN), which includes a flying sensor network with mobile unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and a terrestrial network with stationary sensor nodes. The software complex supports various types of heterogeneous nodes and can simulate different routing and clustering algorithms for routing data in wireless sensor network (WSN). The software complex can perform various types of analysis, including routing efficiency, routing quality of service, and finding optimal clusters. The paper describes a series of experiments and simulations conducted using the software complex and compares the results using different metrics and criteria. This contribution to the field of HWSN provides a new and efficient software complex for modelling routing data.

articleTitle: Technological and Economic Fundamentals Testing of Promising Unmanned Systems, Including Those Controlled Using Intelligent Neural Network Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: An analysis was carried out of the development of the testing system for unmanned aircraft systems, including those controlled through artificial intelligence technologies. It is shown that existing aviation testing technologies do not fully meet the requirements for testing unmanned aircraft systems. A list of technological features and requirements for testing unmanned aircraft systems is provided. A comparative assessment of the cost of testing unmanned aircraft systems using existing and innovative technologies intended for testing such systems is given. Using the developed computer model of a certification testing laboratory for unmanned aircraft systems, the optimal financial and functional indicators of such a laboratory were determined, ensuring the minimum cost of certification tests available to small and medium-sized businesses.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Digital Twin of the Technological Process of Creating a Demonstrator Using R-Pro Digital
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Within the framework of Industry 4.0, one of the innovative solutions in the field of production of autonomous mobile robotic devices is the development and application of digital twins. This technology significantly accelerates the design and optimization of production processes of autonomous moving systems. The article presents the process of developing a digital twin demonstrator for scientific research in the field of autonomous robotics using the program for creating digital twins “Rational production” R-Pro Digital.

articleTitle: Identification of Myers-Briggs Type Indicator Personality Types by Photograph
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the use of deep learning methods in the task of determining a personality type based on photography. The neural network architecture was developed and trained on the data collected specifically for this task. The Myers-Briggs Types Indicator model was used for the typology. This model distinguishes 4 binary scales in personality types. Good model accuracy in each class and high performance of all the metrics used were the results. The resulting model can be used in processing signals from video surveillance cameras and in other areas related to image analysis.

articleTitle: Methodology for Developing Cubesat Remote Sensing Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This research paper provides a methodology for designing a CubeSat type satellite, which will be an Earth remote sensing satellite that will receive data on weather and environmental conditions from a Fourier spectrometer and gamma-ray spectrometer. The nanosatellite will need to be able to conduct research in outer space and in Earth orbit. Technological requirements, main features of development, requirements for operation and maintenance of the CubeSat type satellite are described. The results of calculation of energy parameters of the CubeSat satellite under development, calculation of stable data reception at the ground station from the CubeSat satellite is described. ground station from CUBESAT - 2S satellite.

articleTitle: Multichannel Optical Fibers for the Network F5G
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aspects of the application of multichannel optical fibers in cables and transmission systems of fixed networks F5G are investigated. The loop of optical cable quality and quality management with ensuring the required efficiency are considered. Analytical expressions are given to evaluate the throughput and efficiency of multichannel fibers, and numerical values of efficiency are given. The random process of fiber irregularity with the behavior of directional and resultant modes is described, experimental data are presented. The solution of the problem of optimizing the linear path of the transmission system has been described, the maximum length of the path without intermediate signal regeneration has been calculated.

articleTitle: Equipment Preparation for 26 MHz Band Synchronous DRM Trial Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: We are considering equipment preparation for organizing a local synchronous digital radio broadcasting trial network of the Digital Radio Mondiale (DRM) standard in the 26 MHz band. Two broadcast points were used: “Kurkino” with 500 W average transmitter power and 100 m antenna height; and “MTUCI” with 100 W average transmitter power and 35 m antenna height. A description of the equipment used, the setup procedure and measured parameters are provided. The measurements carried out in the trial zone confirmed the correct operation of the single-frequency network as a whole.

articleTitle: On the Parameters of Algebraic Geometric Codes Designed to Construct a Post-Quantum Algorithm for Ensuring Information Security of On-Board Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article clarifies the parameters of a quantum-resistant algorithm based on AG codes. This algorithm was proposed in previous works by the authors to counter the quantum threat when designing various on-board systems. The article describes the procedure for quickly decoding the corresponding codes, estimates the key length and the probability of applying one of the existing attacks to such algorithms. This work can be useful for increasing the security of arbitrary Internet of Things systems. .

articleTitle: Video Image Recognition of Car Track Characteristics at Intersections
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Automation and improved traffic management are key problems for modern cities and regions. This article presents an approach to the recognition and analysis of traffic flow using the YOLOv8 object detection algorithm. The technique offers an effective solution for detecting vehicles and their movement characteristics. Based on neural networks and deep learning, YOLOv8 provides high accuracy and speed of data processing, which allows you to quickly and accurately determine the movement of cars, motorcycles, bicycles and other objects on the roads. The developed approach has the potential for application in various fields, including traffic flow management, road safety and the development of intelligent transport systems.

articleTitle: Design Software Package to Generation and Analysis of Digital Signals for the Laboratory Workshop “Testing of Radio Equipment”
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Digital laboratory work based on specialized hardware and software complexes is being actively implemented as part of the educational process. There is a strict time limit for students to perform a laboratory work, with a large amount of measurements needed. Because of this, it is necessary to optimize the workflow of educational test cases. This is unattainable when using several software products (that are not related to each other and even do not have compatible data exchange formats or protocols) within the same work. This article discusses the existing model of laboratory work, and ways to increase performance of students in the educational process.

articleTitle: Methodology for Constructing a Spatial Analytical Model of the Route of Urban Passenger Transport Based on the Use of Bezier Curves
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article concerns the issues of constructing a spatial analytical model of the route of a passenger vehicle of public transport with an automated control system. The control system task is automatically maintain the vehicle's movement according to a given schedule. This model is subject to a number of kinematic and dynamic restrictions. In particular, the model must, for each section of the route, describe a separate analytical expression. It determine the maximum permissible speed, which depends on weather conditions that affect the coefficient of adhesion of the car's wheels to the road. The article outlines an approach to constructing a digital route model based on the theory of Bezier curves.

Author Keywords: spatial analytical model of the bus route

articleTitle: On Non-Symmetric Forms of Time-Varying Autocorrelation Function in the Analysis of Cyclostationary Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is aimed at investigating the difference between different forms of time-varying autocorrelation function (TVACF) used for the quantitative expression of the second-order statistical properties exhibiting by non-stationary random processes. The generalized form of TVACF is proposed where the position of the current time moment can be set by means of additional parameter. The relation between the generalized form of TV ACF and its symmetric form is derived for the components of the corresponding cyclic autocorrelation function (CACF). Some invariant has been highlighted which does not depend on the form chosen for the process modelling or estimation. Some symmetry properties held by CACF are discussed. A pulse-amplitude modulated process is considered as a modelled process which sets up an illustrative example which helps to show the visual difference between the correlation diagrams depicting three forms of TV ACF used most frequently in the research sources on cyclostationary analysis.

articleTitle: On the Use of an Acoustic Sensor in the Tasks of Determining Defects in the Roadway
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, an approach to determining pavement defects using an acoustic sensor is considered. The aim of the study is to propose the idea of developing an inexpensive method for detecting various types of damage to the roadway, such as cracks, potholes and irregularities, using acoustic analysis. In the course of the work, the characteristics of sound waves that occur when exposed to defective sections of the road surface were studied. The acoustic sensor allows you to analyze these sound signals and determine the presence and nature of defects based on their changes. The technique includes data collection using an acoustic sensor, signal processing using machine learning algorithms to classify defects and visualization of the results.

articleTitle: Diagnosing the Technical Condition of Heterogeneous Networks of a Spatially Distributed Monitoring System Based on Neural Network Analysis of Telemetry Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article describes a neural network approach to the analysis of telemetry data in the interests of diagnosing the technical condition of telecommunications equipment heterogeneous monitoring networks. A description of the operation of a recurrent neural network is given, which provides a solution to the problem of predicting failures based on telemetry data. The results of assessing the effectiveness of neural network training were obtained using the example of temperature data from the control elements of the monitoring system.

articleTitle: Measuring of Optical Signal to Noise Ratio in High-Speed Coherent Channels of Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper we discuss the methods for measuring optical signal to noise ratio (OSNR) in high-speed coherent channels of optical transmission systems. The following OSNR measurement methods are presented in this article: out-of-band without channel disabling (but such a method has its own limitations in the field of application) and in-band with or without disabling the optical channel. In-band or in-service methods of measuring of the OSNR in next generation optical dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) systems with coherent optical channels, polarization multiplexing and quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) format is still under discussion. This article states that it is preferable to calculate OSNR without disabling the optical channels based on an estimation of the correlation relationships between spectral components at predetermined pairs of spaced wavelengths.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonic Sensing for Temperature Monitoring of On-Board Photovoltaic Panels
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The development and use of on-board photovoltaic panels (PVP) makes it possible to improve the energy supply of unmanned or manned aerial vehicles, which are respectively positioned, for example, as flying base stations or vehicles with on-board batteries with a large energy reserve, capable of carrying more payload during long flights. The efficiency of a photovoltaic element (PVE) is seriously affected by clouds, blocking solar radiation, possible contamination or precipitation accumulated on its protective coating, aging of the PVE material, and the most important parameter - temperature. The aging effects and to a greater extent their temperature, affect the current-voltage characteristics of the PVE, so an on-board measurement system for its performance parameters can provide valuable information for optimizing the power generation process. The article proposes a methodology for monitoring the temperature of PVE and PVP in whole, which provides determination of their temperature over an area based on networks of fiber-optic sensors (FOS) and their addressed interrogation using a microwave-photonic approach.

articleTitle: Investigation of Transit Channel Influence on Rectangular Chain of Coupled Cavities Slow-Wave Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, the slow-wave structures (SWSs) of the “chain of coupled cavities”-type (CCC) were investigated. This type of SWS is widely used for designing the microwave amplifying devices due to their excellent heat dissipation properties allowing for higher output power. The influence of the transit channel, where the electron beam propagates, on the electrodynamic characteristics of the rectangular CCC-type SWS was analysed. Two different forms of the transit channel were considered: for pencil beam and for sheet beam. The 3D modeling in HFSS and processing of the results in MATLAB were performed. It is demonstrated that the presence of the transit channel influences the characteristic impedance and the dispersion characteristics of SWS.

articleTitle: Neural Network for Forecasting Parameters of Broadband Transionospheric Radio Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Methods of synthesis of a special recurrent neural network for the problem of predicting the coherence band of transionospheric radio channels are investigated. An algorithm for data preparation and neural network training has been developed. Validation of the developed neural network was carried out on the data of full-scale experiments conducted with the help of passive radio sensors of global navigation satellite systems using phase and code measurements. The achieved high accuracy of the forecast is experimentally shown using the metrics of the coefficient of determination, MAE and MAPE.

articleTitle: Medium Wave Terrestrial Radio Navigation Systems Antenna Radiation Pattern Distortions Due to Multipath Propagation
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modelling of multipath signal propagation at 1.9 MHz has been carried out for different locations of reradiating objects relative to the transmitting antenna. Objects in the form of a vertical rod, a mast, a flat screen and towers of various shapes are considered. It has been shown that distortions of the phase radiation pattern of more than 10 degrees can appear at distances between the reflecting object and the antenna up to 500 m or more. The object height and shape are of great importance.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Features of Ricocheting Ionospheric Propagation of Decameter Radio Waves
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The ray and caustic features of the ricocheting propagation of decameter radio waves in the Earth's ionosphere have been studied. The rays and caustic structures of radio waves during trans-ionospheric channeled propagation of radiation from an elevated source are calculated using the bicharacteristics method. Ray oscillations arising during circumnavigation of the world have been studied. Using the extended bicharacteristic system method, the Jacobian of the ray flux divergence and, on its basis, the attenuation of the radio signal are calculated.

articleTitle: Location-Aware Beamforming in 5G mmWave UDN. Part 2. Spatial Selection by Beam Width Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Ongoing densification of gNodeB (gNB) and User Equipment (UE) transceivers in 5G and B5G (Beyond 5G) UltraDense Networks (UDN) yields utilization of narrow pencil beams highly relevant. Proper beamforming (BF) at the transmitter and/or receiver requires obtaining accurate Direction of Departure (DOD) and/or Direction of Arrival (DOA) angles in each gNB-UE radio link. Instead of preliminary acquisition of channel state information (CSI), characterized by huge overhead in highly mobile scenarios, Location-Aware Beamforming (LAB) seems to be a more promising approach for emerging compact massive MIMO systems in millimeter waves (mmWave). The contribution of current research is quantitative establishment of the potential for spatial selection of useful Signal-Of-Interest (SOI) by Half Power Beam Width (HPBW) control. The novelty of the proposed research is implementation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{LAB}$</tex> at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{gNB}$</tex> with beam width and orientation adaptation according to location accuracy, characterized by Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of the UE coordinate estimate. Simulation results revealed, that antenna radiation pattern (ARP) beam width control is most effective with a number of antenna elements more than 15 in one dimension for Uniform Rectangular Array (URA) and RMSE more than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$5{\text{\;m}}$</tex>. Matlab source code is available at https://github.com/grihafokin/LAB_spatial_selection.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Skills of Car Drivers Based on the Processing of Telematics Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Based on statistical data on the driving characteristics of vehicles obtained as a result of long-term observation of 19 trucks and cars, the article analyzes assessment methods built into telematics software. It is shown that standard methods for assigning driver ratings are not indicative, as they give contradictory results when compared. Based on well-known approaches, a method for assessing the actions of drivers is proposed based on a comprehensive automated assessment of actions and driving characteristics, which gives more reliable results. From the point of view of predictive determination of states and behavior patterns of vehicle drivers, it is proposed to use the MSET algorithm, and boundary data on the criteria for assessing individual behavior patterns is also provided. The proposed method can be proposed to implement an automated system for assessing driver behavior patterns at minimal cost based on standard telematics information received from connected vehicles.

articleTitle: Aspects of Mathematical Modeling of Complex Processes Realized in Combined Onboard Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The aspects of mathematical modeling of the dynamics of complex processes in complex onboard systems are considered. The structural connections between the elements of modeled systems and their dynamics are formalized using a system of differential equations. Qualitative analysis of the synthesized model allowed establishing new non-local conditions for stable functioning of modeled combined onboard systems. The results obtained make it possible to expand the working areas of technical devices and the devices included in onboard systems.

articleTitle: Model for Calculating Changes in the Radiation Pattern and Amplitude-Phase Distribution in the Subarray of a Large-Aperture APAA Based on a Modified Thermal Conductivity Equation
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper describes a model for calculating and compensating for deviations in the amplitude-phase distribution and radiation pattern of a large-aperture active phased array antenna. As the basis of the mathematical model, a tandem thermal conductivity equation is formalized, which allows one to calculate deviations in phases and amplitudes when calculating the temperature distribution. The advantage of this model is the ability to calculate changes in the radiation pattern and amplitude-phase distribution for each receiving-transmitting module, and then convert them into changes for the entire array.

articleTitle: Provision of Broadcast Multimedia Content in 5G Mobile Systems Using Satellite Broadcasting
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The integration of a satellite network into a 5G mobile communication network is considered in order to provide users with broadcast multimedia content, where satellites can significantly expand coverage. The analysis of architecture options for such a network combining unicast technology with multiuser data transmission technology is carried out. This article explores the possibilities of using satellite broadcasting as an element of the delivery of broadcast multimedia content in 5G mobile communication systems. It is shown that such a combined network becomes capable of ensuring the quality of services, preventing congestion problems and increasing economic efficiency. It is proposed to use the VECTOR-2019 monitoring software and hardware complex for the study of 5G networks.

articleTitle: Large Language Model in Suburban Transport Data Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article explores the new reality of using Large Language Models (LLM) to manage digital data of transport infrastructure based on the concept of artificial intelligence and deep learning of the transport network model as a digital twin of agglomeration. Innovations in the field of artificial intelligence based on data make it possible to make reliable predictions and make optimal decisions to solve scientific problems in this study, but it faces a number of critical problems, including high system complexity, large search space, incomplete knowledge and small amounts of data, and all this requires new strategies to effectively solve these problems. In combination with Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), vehicles can use this data to make more complex decisions, for example, choosing the optimal route depending on the current traffic situation and predicting its changes. LLM's artificial intelligence technology can also be used to create safer vehicles. For example, the system can automatically respond to changes in the traffic situation, preventing traffic accidents and minimizing risks to passengers and others.

articleTitle: Impact of Camera Characteristics and Settings on Precession of AI Object Recognition Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper provides an observation about performance of models of object detection in different conditions of input image quality. Now, there are many different computer vision models suitable for special tasks. Therefore, some of them may not be accurate in some forecasts, but they do not miss a single true value. When choosing a computer vision model, it is necessary to rely on the problems that need to be solved, since there is no universal solution. However, in this article, the choice of models is based on the Average Precision (AP) metric - which allows us to highlight how the model copes with different types of tasks, without losing its accuracy. The MS COCO (Microsoft Common Objects in Context) database was taken as the basis for the measurements, since it is one of the most extensive and rich databases which is used to compare the characteristics of various computer vision technologies, and its dataset covers most areas. The article also discusses metrics and analysis performance, based on what model was selected.

articleTitle: Scientific Approaches to the Identification of Test Objects and Types of Tests for Mobile Research Laboratories in the Field of Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The world practice of organizing research, testing and certification in the field of intelligent transport systems and autonomous movement shows the need to create research laboratories. The research laboratory and test site complexes are an important link in the development, certification and operation of ITS equipment and services, intelligent road infrastructure designed to support the movement of highly automated vehicles, as well as in the development of regulatory and technical requirements at the stage of research experiments. The presence of a sufficient set of research laboratory and testing facilities is the most important key to the development of technical progress. The creation of mobile research laboratories is necessary for the optimal solution of problems arising both at the stages of scientific justification and design and at the stages of construction and operation of ITS projects.

articleTitle: Hardware Interfacing Library for Angle-of-Arrival Estimation in Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses a set of issues related to the implementation of an auxiliary library for interfacing hardware platforms for radio signal acquisition and versatile computer-based signal processing systems aimed at using intellectual approaches such as machine learning and artificial neural networks (ANN). The architecture of the system is considered, including various layers of abstraction for collecting, storing, multistep processing and visualizing information, taking into account the essential features of working in two modes - research and production. A detailed description of the main modules of the system, the principles of their interaction and the position of the intelligent data processing unit in the processing pipeline are provided. The feasibility of the proposed approach was assessed using the example of solving the problem of angle-of-arrival estimation using a pre-trained ANN of modified multilayer perceptron architecture. The paper provides a detailed description of the ANN architecture, the formation of its input data vector, and presents the results of the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Gordon-Mills-Welch Generating Polynomial on its Autocorrelation Properties
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article deals with the generating of pseudo-random Gordon-Mills-Welch sequences with good autocorrelation properties for use in communication and data transmission systems, as spectrum-expanding sequences, scrambling and synchronization functions. Nowadays, there is a significant issue of pure detecting of signals in various types of radio channel. The proper solution of this issue provides new opportunities in the future research. The most important aim of usage of pseudo-random sequences is the reducing of influence of negative effects of channel and maximizing the probability of detecting the low-rate signal because of the unique form of autocorrelation function. Due to this feature, they are commonly used in the area of radars. The main goal of the article is to find out the exact types of Gordon-Mills-Welch sequences with suitable autocorrelation properties.

articleTitle: Implementation of Adaptive Metrics for Vehicle Counting Algorithm via ViDeS Video Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In recent decades, with the development of computing technology, decreasing size and lowering the cost of the component base of devices, it is becoming cheaper and easier to develop systems for capturing, processing and analyzing information about the elements of transport infrastructure. With the growth of cities, increasing population and motorization rates, traffic congestion is becoming more and more of an issue, resulting in lost time, increased pollution and increased likelihood of traffic accidents. The paper presents the application of adaptive metrics for vehicle counting based on the virtual detector system - «ViDES». The algorithm of the system operation, the equipment used and the set of video data for which the study was conducted are described. The object of the study is the influence of metrics implemented in the algorithm of vehicle detection on the accuracy of their counting. The obtained data can be used for more flexible tuning of the developed system, which should lead to an increase in the accuracy of recognizing the characteristics of traffic flows.

articleTitle: Provision of Telecommunications Services with Time-Differentiated Reliability on F5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Growing competition in the telecommunications market is forcing operators to take into account more and more specific needs of their customers and use their resources more efficiently. By offering the option of time-graded reliability, customers can focus more of their spending on critical periods (where the highest reliability is required) and this new option may be attractive to a certain portion of service consumers. The structure of the service level agreement (SLA) is considered, which allows customers to determine the critical time windows (CWO) in which the operator undertakes to meet their requirements for communication reliability. This structure is called SLA with differentiated requirements (SLA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dif</inf>). Fixed networks of the F5G generation have been shown to be well suited to provide SLA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">dif</inf> services. The necessary ratios for assessing the economic efficiency of using SLA with differentiated requirements are obtained, the calculation results are presented, and the data obtained are analyzed.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model for Optimizing the Loading of Trucks for Automated Transportation Management Systems Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Increasing truck loads, expanding transportation processes, and expanding intermodal transportation are exacerbating the impact on road surfaces. Organizations involved in cargo transportation are faced with the need to find effective solutions to optimize processes and select transport, taking into account legal restrictions. The use of automated decision-making systems based on aggregated big-data from telematic control systems is the best practice. The authors consider the problems of implementing systems for estimating mass, load and degree of body loading. Based on data on cost and potential harm to the road, a multicriteria optimization problem is solved to select the optimal transport model. The modified method of searching for Pareto-optimal solutions is used as a mathematical method. The results of experimental studies of the influence of transportation process parameters on the load capacity utilization rate are presented. The resulting mathematical optimization model is ready for integration into automated cargo transportation management systems and has a calculation error of up to 12.8%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection and Object Localization System based on Acoustic Data
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents an approach to the development of an intelligent system for the detection and localization of objects based on acoustic data. The key element of the system implementation is the use of a microphone array that collects acoustic information from various directions. The collected data is fed into a neural network algorithm that is capable of simultaneously analyzing eight sound tracks. Multi-channel processing allows the system to detect the presence of an object in a given area, localize its location and, in the case of directional movement of the object, indicate the trajectory of movement. The system is capable of analyzing audio data in real time, which makes it suitable for applications in various fields, including safety, environmental monitoring and automated surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Studying the Principles of Infocommunication Network Virtualisation Using the Docker Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the use of virtualization technology, and specifically containerization, for building Future Networks. Containerization technology is a type of virtualization that enables software code to be packaged into a single executable file, ensuring its proper execution. These files are referred to as containers. Docker, an open source containerization platform, greatly simplifies and automates the process of creating and deploying various applications. Multiple containers can be quickly deployed on a single machine using the Docker platform. It is a valuable tool for students at the higher education level to gain hands-on experience with the latest technologies. This platform can be utilized for laboratory assignments focused on studying virtualization technologies. It provides an interactive environment for university students to learn a variety of modern networking technologies, including configuration of new servers and running applications on them. The platform can be used by students and professors to explore modern infocommunication network structures and databases for research. Familiarity with Docker is becoming more and more important in the IT sector, which makes it a valuable skill for students looking for a job.

articleTitle: Methods to Improve the Accuracy of State Estimation in Nonlinear Kalman Filter in Case of a Priori Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of estimating the state of a complex system with nonlinear dynamic behavior using nonlinear filtering. Modern numerical methods of nonlinear filtering for estimating the unknown state vector of a stochastic differential system of Itô type with discrete measurements are studied. The relevance of the work is due to the necessity to improve the accuracy of state vector estimation in dynamic systems under conditions of a priori uncertainty of information about the system functions and measurement. In this paper, a nonlinear system with formant Wiener noise is considered. As the chosen method of nonlinear filtering the sigma-point Kalman filter is used, which has sufficient accuracy of state vector estimation at low computational complexity. The paper discusses ways to improve the accuracy of nonlinear system vector estimation using sigma-point Kalman filter. Mathematical description of the sigma-point Kalman filter operation is given, and the methods of improving the quality of operation under conditions of a priori unknown functions of the system and measurement by estimating the values of covariance matrices of random processes are proposed. The paper presents the results of modeling of the sigma-point Kalman filter for both linear and nonlinear measurement functions. The obtained values of RMS error under conditions of a priori uncertainty of system and measurement functions under approximation of covariance matrices have the same order as in the case of a priori known functions. The paper presents the results of nonlinear filtering simulation at different values of the sampling period. In conclusion, recommendations for the choice of parameters of the sigma-point Kalman filter when working under conditions of a priori uncertainty of system and measurement functions are given.

Author Keywords: Ito-type stochastic differential equation with discrete dimensions
estimation of the state vector of a nonlinear system

articleTitle: Application of Window Functions for Estimation of Spectral Correlation Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of enhancing spectral correlation function (SCF) estimation, which is the frequency domain characteristic describing the second-order statistical properties of cyclostationary processes. The algorithm based on two-dimensional FFT procedure is chosen as a base SCF estimation algorithm. It is shown that this algorithm can be transformed so as to involve the use of a window function in order to reduce the variance of the SCF estimates. The results of the application of some well-known window functions in addition to the rectangle are shown altogether with the analysis of the estimation accuracy dependence on the window functions shape and width. It is shown that according to the type of cyclostationary process under study, the optimal width and shape of the window function can be chosen in terms of the minimum root mean square error criterion. As an example of cyclostationary process, it is considered base-band BPSK signal observed in an additive Gaussian noise. Monte Carlo simulations are performed and SCF estimation accuracy is analyzed

articleTitle: Robust Stochastic Estimation Based on a Modified Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The practical application of schemes for estimating the state of nonlinear stochastic systems built on the basis of the Kalman filter is limited by the need for an accurate a priori description of the dynamics of the observed object and the measurement process, as well as the probabilistic characteristics of object noise and measurement interference. The absence of this information leads to instability in the assessment process. Despite the numerous modifications of the Kalman filtering scheme, the problem of increasing the filtering accuracy in the absence of information about the probabilistic characteristics of object noise and measurement interference has not yet had a satisfactory solution. In this regard, the article discusses a new approach to constructing a robust Kalman filtering scheme. The proposed robust filtering method is based on the synthesis of the filter gain from the condition of minimizing a nonlinear functional determined by the most unfavorable class of measurement noise distributions. In addition to robust properties, the resulting filter has a significantly smaller dimension compared to the Kalman filter, which coincides with the dimension of the object, which sharply reduces the computational costs of its implementation. The results of a numerical experiment illustrating the effectiveness of the considered approach are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Characteristics of Synchronization System Components for High-Speed Data Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The creation of devices that control the transfer of information in optical systems with the highest data transfer rates is an urgent task and involves both scientific research and experimental development. The paper analyzes circuit solutions and obtains simulation results for voltage controlled oscillator (VCO) circuits and the entire PLL system (PLL). The main components of the PLL: phase detector (PD), VCO and counter-frequency divider (C-FD) are implemented using classical CMOS circuitry. The solutions we proposed in our work for implementing components on CMOS transistors with design standards of 90 and 65 nm allowed us to implement a frequency synthesizer model that allows us to ensure the operation of on-board devices for OFDM and MIMO technologies, which are used in optical systems for high-speed data transmission.

articleTitle: Improving an Effective Information Storage Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The presented materials are dedicated to the development of research into a method for efficient lossless information storage. They analyze the previously noted disadvantages of the proposed storage method and discuss ways to eliminate them. In addition, the possibility of increasing the entropy of stored information through the use of relative data compression methods is described. One of the popular methods that has proven its effectiveness in practice and has become a prototype used in the work is differential pulse-code modulation. This is a method of compact data presentation, which is based on predicting subsequent values of signal samples. It is carried out by subtracting the signal from the current - previous value of the signal, the resulting difference is encoded by entropy methods. Previous work has demonstrated the fundamental feasibility of implementing integrated circuit-based encoding, which has led to the creation of a software implementation algorithm that allows the creation of a model of mutually orthogonal unary codes capable of compactly storing large amounts of data

articleTitle: Simulation of Road Environment Conditions for the Purposes of Organizing Polygonal Tests of Unmanned Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the issues of simulating road environmental conditions, which are carried out with the aim of organizing tests of unmanned vehicles. In particular, the article discusses the purposes for which it is necessary to conduct field tests of unmanned vehicles and, as a result, simulate the conditions in which these vehicles may find themselves. Examples of specific situations that can be simulated for testing unmanned vehicles are given. The paper also provides examples of how road environmental conditions can be modeled at different scales. Preparing highly automated vehicles for operation on public roads by conducting tests at specialized testing sites will allow testing the safety and reliability of highly automated vehicles both for the users themselves and for other road users.

articleTitle: Space Monitoring Systems Measuring Receiver Development
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the process of developing a measuring receiver for testing radio tags of space monitoring systems. The relevance of this development is revealed, the scope of its application is considered. A method for constructing a high-precision control and measuring complex for calculating the parameters of radio tag transmitters for space monitoring systems based on the stricture of a direct conversion receiver is discussed. The shortcomings of the structure of the direct conversion receiver and options for compensating for them in this development through the use of a pre-calibration system of the control and measuring stand are analyzed. The principle of operation of the pre-calibration system is discussed. A structural and functional diagram of the control and measuring stand being developed is given. Interim development results are presented, a calibration frequency synthesizer controlled by a microcontroller was assembled, its characteristics were measured in laboratory conditions, and the results of the user software, calibration and demodulation of test signals are presented.

articleTitle: On the Application of Human Pose Estimation in a Driver Condition Monitoring Task
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Going on a trip, however, this does not guarantee the normal condition of the driver while driving. This paper proposes a method of monitoring the driver based on video images that are processed by a neural network and determines such indicators as head movement, arm movement, and upper shoulder joints. The paper compares the main architectures of neural network frameworks: AlphaPose, OpenPose, PoseNet and Mask R-CNN. Mathematical description of kinematics of human hands and head movement is given A program continuous monitoring of driver's condition by means of video image processing in real conditions is proposed.

articleTitle: Inherent Impedance Transformation and Isolation in Dual-Band Balun For RF Front End Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents a balun architecture with the inherent impedance transformation between the balanced and unbalanced ports. Also, the balun provides the isolation between the balanced ports while working at the two arbitrary frequencies concurrently. The systematic design analysis of the proposed balun architecture is also provided in the paper with the analytical design equations in closed-form. The working of the proposed balun architecture is also demonstrated through the electromagnetic simulation on an industry standard simulation tool working at a frequency ratio (r =2) and impedance ratio (k=2). The simulation results of the optimized electromagnetic architecture are in good agreements with the calculated results.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Neural Network Methods for Recognizing Noisy Speech Audio Files
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this work an approach to training neural networks for speech transcription using artificially generated and noisy data is investigated and developed. The purpose of the work is to determine the effectiveness of the proposed methods for recognizing noisy speech using neural network technologies. The relevance of the study is determined by the emerging new possibilities for noise compensation in audio files using neural network technologies. A study of existing noise affecting the training of a neural network was carried out. A data noise module was designed and developed, and a test bench was assembled. In the course of practical research, a slight improvement in text recognition by a neural network for speech transcription was identified, and options for improving the quality of recognition were proposed. Methods of system analysis and experimental research determine the methodology of this study.

Author Keywords: training neural networks on noisy data

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of roadside Units Deployment Models in V2X Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This study investigates the placement of roadside units (RSUs) in vehicle-to-everything systems. The placement is carried out using a heat-map method, where less efficient RSUs are removed after each optimization pass. Such an approach allows reducing the number of stationary RSUs in the system, thereby lowering the material costs associated with organizing such a system. The optimized system is compared to placement using the constrained Delaunay triangulation (CDT) method. Additionally, the optimization of the system using mobile roadside units (mRSUs) is also compared. The results indicate that mRSUs not only reduce the load on RSUs but, given a sufficient quantity, can also fully replace stationary RSUs.

articleTitle: Adaptive Signal Decomposition Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Digital signal processing methods are crucial in analyzing radio signals, especially in complex radio electronic environments (REE). With advancements in radio communication, navigation, and control systems, REE often hosts multiple sources operating on the same or adjacent spectrum segments, representing various radio systems. Consequently, signal mixing from different sources with additive noise occurs on the receiving end. Adaptive signal decomposition methods like Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD), and Empirical Wavelet Transform (EWT) are employed to address such complexities. These methods enable the breakdown of intricate signals into simpler components without predefining basis decomposition functions. For instance, EMD identifies intrinsic modes, VMD separates modes using a variational approach, while EWT adaptively selects wavelets for decomposition. Each method boasts distinct advantages and limitations, and the selection of a specific approach hinges on signal characteristics and the required precision of analysis. This article offers a concise examination of these adaptive signal decomposition algorithms, outlining their descriptions and exploring their potential applications in radio engineering research.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Distributing Data between Storage Systems Based on the Property of Self-Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper considers the data distribution algorithm that is responsible for how data can be entered into the system or obtained from it. The algorithm is based on the property of self-similarity, which is inherent in fractals. As an implementation model, two distribution models based on sectors and rings are proposed, the geometric dimensions of which are determined from the normalized reliability of data storage systems. The main criterion for choosing a model is computational efficiency. The proposed approach will improve the reliability of data storage and optimize data distribution.

articleTitle: Building Structures Image Matching Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper examines the features of combining multi-temporal and multi-angle images of building structures in order to identify critical changes. It is proposed to carry out such a combination on the basis of high-speed pseudogradient algorithms. The focus of the work is the problem of identifying areas of attention that are the source of combined points. It is proposed to perform such selection using convolutional neural networks of the YOLO family. The consistency of this approach is shown and estimates of the resulting gains are also calculated. It is also suggested to use different optimization methods for improving the processing speed. So the YOLO detector will be very high performance and efficient real time detector.

articleTitle: On Board Communications: Systems of Signals Processing and Radiofrequency Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the main topics and results of the scientific conference “Systems of signals generating and processing in the field of on board communications”, in which leading industry experts annually exchange experience in the areas of: antennas and radio waves propagation, navigation and mathematical algorithms of an object Space orientation, radiofrequency applications, wire and optical communication and control systems, intelligent transport systems and digital signal processing in on-board radio systems.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Control Signals for Analog Automata Small-Sized Technical Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The report discusses the organization of a distributed control system based on continuous logic. The proposed solutions expand the capabilities of cyber-physical systems by increasing their performance and reliability while reducing energy consumption. Promising areas of application are analogue automatic control systems for microelectromechanical and microelectronic devices. The work is aimed at the development of analog computing in the direction of transition to the creation of distributed analog computing structures that continuously synthesize control signals in real time. In analog cyber-physical networks, the temporal gap between physical and computational processes is eliminated. To create hardware control algorithms in real time, continuum logic of interaction between analogue control devices is used. Examples of the use of analogue automatic in robot control systems are given.

articleTitle: Methods of Descriptive Statistics in Telemetry Tasks
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This discourse investigates methodologies for the computation of quantile estimates and descriptive statistics within the framework of telemetry challenges. This undertaking gains significance in the planning and execution of surveillance systems, particularly in scenarios involving heavily burdened distributed systems or the deployment of load balancers. This pertinence arises due to the pivotal role played by limited computational resources in such systems. Concretely, this article delves into approaches encompassing moving quantile estimates, the square P quantile estimator, the data structure of partitioning heaps, and methods such as the Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) and Shamos estimates to address variations. The elucidation herein is intended to contribute to the advancement of precision and efficiency in the realm of telemetry problem-solving.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning to Identify a Camera By Photo Image with On Board Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article explores the use of classical machine learning and Automnl methods to solve the problem of camera identification from photo images in the absence of metadata and limited computational and resource capabilities in on board communications. The experiments were conducted on the well-known Forchheim Image Database dataset using the Python programming language and libraries such as scikit-learn, auto-sklearn, skimage and pandas. The paper discusses the use of a local binary pattern (LBP) descriptor in combination with various filtering methods. A comparison of the classification results for each algorithm using different confidence and performance evaluation metrics was carried out. The experimental results showed that the Auto-sklearn algorithm achieved the best performance indicators when using the bilateral filtering method.

articleTitle: Neural Network Method for Removing the Effect of Atmospheric Noise in an Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to develop a neural network method for dealing with noise in the form of weather conditions. The existing methods for cleaning images from noise were analyzed. The architecture of neural network deraining method based on modernized ResNeXt is proposed. Based on the results of testing the combination of information from the detail layer and negative residual information, the training process is simplified by reducing the range of mapping. Experiments demonstrated successful transfer of the model to real-world images with a significant improvement in the prediction accuracy of the pre-trained model on photos from rainy conditions.

articleTitle: Development of Turbo Product Code with Elementary Encoders as LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Increasing the environmental safety of agricultural machinery is a key direction in the development of automotive and tractor engineering. The current situation with tractor technology indicates the need to update and improve the tractor fleet as a whole, and especially in relation to small and medium traction classes of 0.6-2.0. Solving the problems of greening and updating the tractor fleet is facilitated by the creation of tractor equipment with a hybrid electric drive. Available developments make it possible to offer the most efficient hybrid electric drive schemes suitable for use in tractor technology. Based on the existing experience of tractor manufacturing, it is possible to determine a list of traction classes required for replacement. Using worldwide experience in creating tractors with electric drive, it is possible to determine the requirements for traction batteries sufficient for their use in a tractor with a hybrid drivetrain. In total, schemes and basic technical requirements for a tractor with a hybrid drivetrain are proposed. The benefits of using such solutions in the long term are preliminarily described.

articleTitle: Analysis of Non-Recurrent Algorithms for Detecting 4-QAM Signal in a MIMO System with Different Numbers of Antennas
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper investigates non-recurrent algorithms for obtaining soft solutions for a four-position quadrature amplitude modulation (4-QAM) signal in conditions of estimating communication channel parameters with different accuracy in a communication system with multiple transmitting and receiving antennas (MIMO). The communication channel was modeled using the Jakes model, which takes into account Doppler spreading and Rayleigh fading of the signal. The additive noise was assumed to be white Gaussian. The channel matrix takes into account the distortions received by the signal in the direct conversion receiver path, such as amplitude and phase imbalance between signal quadratures, phase noise, frequency shift remaining after the demodulation procedure, and DC components. The noise immunity of the proposed regularizing procedures was compared with the known algorithms Zero Forsing, minimum mean square error (MSE) and a procedure based on the least squares method (LSM) for a MIMO system with a number of antennas of 8, 16, 32 and 64. The computational experiment showed that that a regularizing algorithm for finding soft solutions can provide an energy gain in noise immunity with inaccurately known parameters of the communication channel relative to other signal detection procedures considered in this work.

articleTitle: Software-Defined Radio Wireless Communication Technology Design. LibreSDR Board Validation
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Currently, most of the technical solutions for wireless communications and navigation systems prototyping and validation in academic and scientific community employ Software Defined Radio (SDR) technology. However, wider utilizing of popular and well proven SDR platforms, such as USRP (Universal Software Radio Peripheral), LimeSDR and AD-FMCOMMS boards, is still difficult due to high cost and low availability. One of the solutions to popularize and make SDR wireless communication technology design more accessible for academic and scientific community is the emerging low-cost SDR-platform LibreSDR. Current work is devoted to experimental validation of LTE compliant transmission and reception of reference signals on physical layer, using LibreSDR board. The results of the experimental validation prove the potential of relatively low-cost LibreSDR utilization for wireless communications and navigation systems prototyping with the same performance, as well known USRP boards, among young scientists and students during their education and research in the academic and scientific community.

articleTitle: The Impact of Omnichannel Architecture on Customer Service Characteristics in Modern Contact Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Modern contact centers actively use an omnichannel approach to provide customers with the opportunity to get the information they need anytime, anywhere. Every year, more and more people contact companies or government organizations through requests via email, chat or instant messenger. Very often the request contains a file with which the client describes his problem. Obviously, this aspect should be reflected in the mathematical models and methods that are used to plan contact centers. A similar model is discussed in the article. Its main characteristics are provided. The system of state equations needed to calculate different parameters of the model is presented. Using the constructed model, the number of agents required to service two-flow client requests is calculated.

articleTitle: Development of the IoT Device for Permanent Diagnostics of Electric Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper presents a developed system for permanent monitoring of electric motors that are part of industrial equipment. This device was developed for the purpose of permanent monitoring and diagnostics of electric motors and aggregation of collected data of electric motor status into a shared database of an industrial enterprise. The system consists of an IoT device, an Android application and a remote server. IoT device is presented as a breadboard with ESP32 controller, memory module and a set of sensors (vibration, temperature, Hall sensor) necessary for monitoring the state of the electric motor and its primary diagnostics. Android application for mobile device is necessary for collecting data of electric motor parameters from IoT device via Wi-Fi, for sending these data to a single database on a remote server, for controlling IoT device and for visualizing graphs of measured parameters

articleTitle: Construction of a Communication Channel with UAVs Based on Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) are actively used to solve various problems: monitoring the earth's surface, delivering goods, relaying signals, special military tasks, etc. A feature of UAV monitoring of the earth's surface is the need to transmit the video stream recorded by the on-board optical-electronic system of the device to a ground control point in real time. To transmit high-quality video, a radio channel with high information transmission speed is required. The construction of such communication channels is possible through the use of signals with complex signal-code structures. One of the ways to increase the efficiency of information transmission and construct complex signal-code structures is to use the method of expanding the signal spectrum. This article discusses the option of building a communication channel with medium-range unmanned aerial vehicles based on direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) signals. It has been shown that it is possible to build a communication channel with a UAV with a speed of up to 150 Mbit/s on a range of more than 100 km when using not very long pseudorandom sequence (PRS). The use of longer PRS will significantly reduce the communication range, but will significantly increase the energy secrecy of the channel, which is important for special-purpose UAVs.

articleTitle: Open-Form Tests for Control in Teaching Technical Disciplines of Communication Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The optimal form of test tasks from the point of view of computerization of the testing process are test tasks with an open form of test answer. In tasks of this kind there is no “rigid list” of alternative answer options - the correct answer must be given by the test taker himself, and this answer must indicate the quality of his knowledge. Thus, the main disadvantage of test items with multiple answer options is eliminated. Open test tasks have their own specific requirements both for the formulation of the question and for the logical certainty of the content of the task itself. The article describes examples of such test tasks for teaching technical disciplines and, in particular, communication theory disciplines, as well as testing requirements.

articleTitle: User Authentication and Authorization While Accessing a Virtual Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A virtual laboratory of modern network technologies was created to enable the laboratory to function without constant supervision from teaching staff, allow for individualization of the learning process, and provide remote accessibility from outside the educational organization. The paper considers the architecture of a virtual laboratory for providing access to students, demonstrates the method of user authentication and authorization for access to the equipment, and illustrates the operability of the system. The process of installing and configuring means of authentication and authorization for remote access to the virtual laboratory is described. The study proves that when providing remote access to a virtual laboratory for a large number of users and experiencing high load on the RADIUS server, it is effective to store credentials in a database. A PostgreSQL server is taken as an example in this paper. This approach is useful for the construction and adaptation of virtual laboratories

articleTitle: The Complex Representation of an Audio Signal in Tasks of its Analysis and Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The existing algorithms for compact representation and analysis of audio signals have reached a high level of development. Further advancement is possible by using the complex representation of the signal, which requires the formation of an orthogonal signal from the original signal with high accuracy. The algorithm proposed below allows reducing the conversion error to the magnitude of 10^-5. The complex representation of the signal enables the evaluation of its properties that are important for subjective assessment by the listener and facilitates non-inertial signal level processing. Examples of original measurement and processing algorithms are provided.

articleTitle: Location-Aware Beamforming in 5G mmWave UDN. Part 1. Spatial Selection by Beam Shape Control
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Beamforming (BF) using massive MIMO systems and antenna arrays (AA) on gNodeB (gNB) and user equipment (UE) is a breakthrough technology for 5G and B5G (Beyond 5G) Ultra-Dense Networks (UDN). The use of narrow beams makes it possible to compensate for high propagation losses in the range of millimeter waves (mmWave), as well as to solve the problem of densification of gNB and UE transceivers with their spatial selection. An approach of utilizing current location of UE, to which the gNB should orient its narrow beam, is termed Location-Aware Beamforming (LAB). The contribution of current research is quantitative establishment of the potential for spatial selection of useful Signal-Of-Interest (SOI) and suppressing interfering Signal-Not-Of-Interest (SNOI) for the scenario of two gNB→UE radio links, simultaneously operating in the same frequency band. Simulation results revealed, that antenna radiation pattern (ARP) maximum & null beam shape control is most effective with a small number of antenna elements and small UE location error. Matlab source code is available at https://github.com/grihafokin/LAB_spatial_selection.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Interactive Educational Technologies in Training Students in Electrical and Electronic Engineering Specialties
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: modern society needs a completely new model of the education system, because in order to train highly qualified specialists it is very important to teach them to correctly interact with various sources of information, analyze and effectively use them subsequently. The development of a fundamentally new model, which will be based on the use of information and communication technologies, will significantly improve the qualifications of personnel and bring modern enterprises to a new level. Using the example of the subject electrical and electronic engineering, the article provides guidelines for designing classes using interactive methods.

articleTitle: Sub-Nyquist Sampling of Bandpass Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The paper studies the process of folding the spectrum of a bandpass signal as a result of uniform sub-Nyquist sampling. Most publications on bandpass sampling consider optimal sampling to avoid aliasing. This article takes into account the possibility of aliasing of an arbitrary degree. The knowledge gained in this area is necessary for use in the study of multi-channel multi-frequency sampling, which provides the ability to restore a bandpass signal distorted by aliasing in channels. To make it possible to study the consequences of sub-Nyquist sampling at any ratio of sampling frequency and signal spectrum width and at any position of the signal on the frequency axis, at any degree of aliasing. Research is carried out on a plane whose axes are the lower bounding frequency of the signal band and the frequency itself. It is shown that the structure of this plane is a periodic continuation along both axes of a certain pattern. Therefore, it is enough to limit ourselves to studying only this pattern. The paper provides a structural analysis of this pattern and derives expressions that allow one to understand the consequences of sub-Nyquist uniform sampling for any of its parameters.

articleTitle: Energy-Based Spectrum Sensing Over the Severe Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The presented research analyzes the energy-based detection (ED) problem of a signal propagating in a wireless severely fading channel. To account for the worst-case propagation conditions, the newly presented for wireless communications Lomax channel model (exhibiting the hyper-Rayleigh conditions for all the possible parameters' range) was used. The system performance was characterized by the average probability of detection, receiver operating characteristic (ROC), and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), that were studied as the functions of the system and the channel parameters (i.e., the sensing base., the average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and the SNR probability distribution function scale parameter). The results of the numerical simulation were analyzed in comparison with the existing regulation implied by the 5G NR standard on the ED for medium access procedure.

articleTitle: Scientific and Methodological Support for the Interoperability of Intelligent Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The main trends in the development of intelligent transport systems are considered. It is shown that the relevance of the problem of interoperability is increasing in the context of digital transformation of the transport industry. One approach to ensuring interoperability is open systems technology and functional standardization. Methodological approaches to localizing interoperability barriers for further optimization are considered and problems are formulated that can be solved using fuzzy logic calculation algorithms.

articleTitle: Analysis of Information Flows Distribution with a Load Balancer in Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work is devoted to building a model for distributing information flows in data centers using a load balancer. The main material is devoted to a detailed consideration of two methods of distributing information flows in data centers - static balancing and dynamic balancing by the method of least connections. The balancing logic using the method of the least number of connections was implemented on network equipment - Cisco routers and switches and in the GNS3 network modeling program. Within the framework of this implementation, a simplified model of a data center is presented, and the dependences of quality of service characteristics on input data are constructed based on an analysis of real traffic. The solutions proposed in this work can be successfully used when planning the architecture of modern data centers and can be used in combination with a number of already used load balancer operating models.

articleTitle: Error Correction Codes Parameters Optimization in Wideband HF Range Digital Voice Radio Links
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of the important areas of development of communication systems in the shortwave range is voice communication systems. An urgent task for such communication systems is to increase noise immunity, which allows increasing the range of the system, reducing power consumption and, as a consequence, the size and weight of the user device. The greatest noise immunity of voice communication lines in modern realities can be achieved by an approach that implements voice transmission in digital format, using voice codec to convert speech into a set of bits and back. In this case, the main way to increase the noise immunity of such communication systems is to reduce the probability of a bit error at the error correcting code output. The purpose of this work is to develop a methodology for determining the parameters of an error correcting code, synchronization sequences and direct spread sequence spectrum signal code construction, allowing to minimize the probability of a bit error for a given signal-to-noise ratio and channel model parameters for AWGN and multipath Rayleigh channels.

articleTitle: Analytical Model of the Working Processes On-Board Information and Computing Network Users
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: One of recent advances in innovation computer technologies is widely using of on-board computing complexes. The major part of the on-board computing complex is the on-board information and computing network. Its main purpose is to ensure the reliable operation of on-board equipment. To design an on-board information and computer network, it is necessary to develop its mathematical model at the first stage. At the same time, most of the available models imply the working of network users with a “simple dialogue mode”, i.e. do not take into account the real technology of their work. However, it is possible to identify typical tasks solved by each of the users of the network, and describe in detail their working technology.
