Detailed consideration of network user's operation technology and its inclusion in the model can have a significant impact on its probabilistic and temporal characteristics. We consider some examples of such models by using closed queueing networks.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model of the Process of Technical Operation of the Data Center Information Cable System According to the “On Demand” Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A variant of technical operation of the data center's information cable system is considered, based on a gradual increase in its resources in the process of reaching the facility's design capacity (“on demand”). The prospects of applying this strategy are shown both in terms of the overall saving of financial resources and the possibility of allocating capital investments over time. Separately, it is indicated the need to apply appropriate design solutions in terms of cable routes as a necessary condition for the implementation of the strategy.

articleTitle: Implementing Suburban Transport Demand Planning with Metaverse and Digital Twin Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the issue of developing transport systems based on metaverse technology for planning decisions on managing transport suburban in an augmented reality and virtual reality environment when collecting and analyzing digital data to understand the forecast of the future display of the virtual world based on the rapid response of various transport units based on rapid training on real simulated objects of the transport and road network. Thus, the use of virtual reality in planning a transport suburban helps to increase the efficiency and safety of the transport system, as well as improve the quality of life of citizens. The mathematical model of the transport network under study considered, based on the technology of the metaverse, augmented reality and data from the digital twin of the urban suburban.

articleTitle: Measuring Far-Field Radiation Patterns of Digital Beamforming Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A method of the antenna array far-field Radiation Pattern (RP) measurement is considered. This method is designed for the usage with the receiving Digital Beamforming Antenna Arrays (DBAA). Such type of antenna arrays typically does not have a radiofrequency output. Hence, the standard methods of the RP measurement, based on the radiation and the reception of the monochromatic probing signal, cannot be used for the DBAA RP measurement. The proposed method assumes the radiation of a probing signal modulated by a pseudo-noise sequence and the base-band processing of the DBAA output signal by means of a matched filter or a correlator. The paper presents the description of the measurement setup and the mathematical explanation of the measuring procedure. It has been shown that the accuracy of the RP measurement depends on the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) at the outputs of the DBAA channel receivers, the number of the array channels and the number of the pseudo-noise sequence symbols. The accuracy increases on 3 dB each time as the number of the array antennas or the pseudo-noise sequence symbols is doubled. This result is confirmed by the simulation of the RP measurement of the eight and the sixteen channel linear antenna arrays with the usage of the maximum length pseudo-noise sequence of 1023 and 2047 symbols.

articleTitle: Research on Driver Monitoring Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This paper investigates the application of machine learning techniques to analyze and classify the state of a vehicle driver while driving to improve road safety. Driver states were analyzed for loss of attention while driving. The object of the study was video images from cameras located in vehicles and directed at drivers. Four models were analyzed in Jupyter notebook environment using NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib. The results of the analysis show that EfficientNet-B0 is the best algorithm and that it can be effectively applied in future studies and predictions.

articleTitle: Methods for Increasing the Efficiency of Amplitude-Phase Modulated Signals Power Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Despite the widespread development of satellite mobile communications, radio communications in the high frequency range (3 - 30 MHz) retains its position when it is necessary to ensure over-the-horizon data transmission with low delays. The transmission speed of samples from the world's leading manufacturers reaches 120 kbit/s with a used radio channel width of 24 kHz. Manpack radios place high demands on weight and size characteristics, which are largely determined by the efficiency of the most energy-intensive unit - the power amplifier (PA). The article analyzes ways to increase the PA efficiency taking into account the features of modern telecommunication signals that use amplitude-phase modulation and have a large crest factor. Based on a preliminary analysis of a wide range of directions for increasing the radio frequency amplifiers efficiency, the most promising options for the problem under consideration are selected: a power amplifier with envelope elimination and restoration (EER) and an amplifier using the outphasing method. To date, the theoretical issues of constructing the EER PA and the prospects for its practical implementation have been better developed. At the same time, the potential capabilities of a transmitter built using the outphasing method are higher than those of the EER PA, since it does not have an inertial low-frequency envelope path, which reduces both energy performance and limits the possibility of improving quality characteristics. A conclusion is made about the advisability of further research, modeling, prototyping and testing of the transmitter using the outphasing method.

articleTitle: Ship Dynamics in the Dynamic Positioning Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article deals with the issues of control to maintain constant coordinates by the ship while performing various operations. Ship model present as a dynamic object in a full six-dimensional coordinate system. Based on the concept of connectivity of the components of the state vector and, based on Hamilton's principle, it is proposed to use the model in the form of a system of second-order differential equations. In contrast to the model in the Cauchy form, all measurable coordinates of the state vector and acceleration, velocity and displacement are taken into account here. In order to ensure the necessary characteristics, the method of the theory of invariant control is applied. The ship model is considered in six-dimensional space.

articleTitle: Development of Turbo Product Code with Elementary Encoders as LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This work explores the possibility of using low-density parity check codes as elementary encoders for turbo product code. This approach has prospects for implementation in digital video broadcasting - satellite communication standard version 2. The article describes in detail the algorithm for implementing an encoder and layered belief propagation decoder for a turbo product code based on low density parity check codes, taking into account turbo code elementary codes operation specificity. The result of the work is an estimate of the noise immunity of turbo product codes using codes with low-density parity check for the noise immunity of the communication system used in digital video broadcasting - satellite communication standard version 2. The bit error rate was used as a criterion for noise immunity.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Balancing in Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: With the increase in the number of Internet users and the number of applications running on the cloud, the need for computing power in data centers is increasing every day. One solution to the problem of increasing traffic consumption is the use of dynamic load balancing in data centers based on a rate-limited access model, which is aimed at increasing the efficiency of data centers through dynamic load distribution. The article discusses the basic principles of a data center, load balancing, and presents a model of dynamic resource allocation with access speed limitation. Based on the considered model, a mathematical model of load balancing in data centers is presented. The final section analyzes the presented mathematical model.

articleTitle: Development of Technical Project Management Competencies Based on the Gamification Method and the Efficiency Synergy Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In conditions of high rates of scientific and technological progress and digital development, the question of compliance of existing competencies of technical specialists with the requirements of a new technological order is relevant. The article is devoted to substantiating the need to modernize higher engineering education based on new learning tools and technologies, including the gamification method. It is proposed to use the game situation for the development of universal and general professional competencies of engineering students in evaluating the effectiveness and management of technical projects. The solution to the problem is to develop a gamification algorithm, stages and conditions of the game procedure for evaluating the synergy of project effectiveness based on the integrated expert method.

Author Keywords: the game evaluation procedure of the project

articleTitle: The Mathematical Model of a Multiservice Access Node in the Private LTE Network
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: At the moment, private LTE (pLTE) networks are one of the most popular and promising ways to organize communications and provide various services at production facilities. They attract the attention of mobile network operators, vendors, system integrators, and standardization organizations. Private LTE networks make it possible to provide reliable and stable connections for all types of devices operating within the enterprise. It is important that this solution allows to connect mobile subscribers and Internet of Things devices into a network using one unified technology. A mathematical model of the formation and joint transmission of information flows in a private LTE access node has been constructed and studied. Definitions of quality indicators for servicing incoming requests are given, and a recursive method for their evaluation is considered.

articleTitle: Best Practices for Updating Terminology Base when Foreign Language Studying
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The field of electronics and electrical engineering is rapidly advancing, resulting in the emergence of many new technical terms. Therefore, foreign language studies, in particular studying English for professional communication, in higher education institutions should be organized to help students not only learn basic vocabulary related to their profession, but also adopt a systematic approach and consistent practice to master foreign language terminology throughout their careers. The aim of this study is to analyze methods and approaches to learning terminology in higher education in order to identify the most effective methods and use them to build a model that encourages students' autonomy in identifying, retaining and using terms appropriately in their professional activities. It is concluded that a shift of the focus from teaching foreign languages to learning them is required. This involves mastering strategies and methods for acquiring emerging terms and concepts, which allows graduates to stay updated and relevant in their industry. A step-by-step model is proposed for students to acquire professional vocabulary through interactive tasks completed in the study room, self-directed learning with ICT (Information and Communication Technologies), and project activities. The model focuses on developing students' skills to work independently with terminology in their professional environment. It can be used to study terminology in any field, with tasks tailored to their specific area of study.

articleTitle: Common Cause Failures in Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: Upcoming communication networks are designed to provide a variety of mission-critical applications, so they are subject to strict dependability and survivability requirements, to meet which redundancy is usually used. However, the effect of its use can be significantly reduced by common cause failures, leading to the simultaneous outages of several or even many network elements. Therefore, an analysis of such failures is necessary. The article proposes a method that takes into account the possibility of common cause failures when calculating network availability. In addition, the concept of a shared risk resource group is considered, as well as the alarm correlation in fault management systems that are directly related to common cause failures.

articleTitle: Comparison of the Efficiency and Energy Consumption of an Electric Wheel Loader and a Diesel Loader
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The study focuses on the efficiency of diesel and electric forklifts in an industrial plant. Diesel forklifts have a fuel consumption of 8–17 l/h, and the average during loading is 12.4 l/h. The electric forklift operates for 7–8 hours, charges up to 70% in 45 minutes, with an hourly electricity consumption of 31 kWh. It is recommended to optimize the operating modes of diesel forklifts, reducing downtime. Operating time at rated power and minimum load shows significant inactivity. An electric forklift is more efficient in terms of efficiency (0.77 in motion and 0.87 in hydraulic operation) compared to a diesel one (0.25 and 0.28). This highlights the benefits of electrical systems in using energy efficiently, helping to save resources. A comparison of performance when loading sand shows that the electric loader is slightly more productive, despite the charging time, which is important when choosing equipment.

articleTitle: Research of the Efficiency of Using LDPC, Turbo Product and Polar Codes with OCDM-OChDM
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: This article discusses the using of various code structures in systems with cascaded multiple access Orthogonal Code Division Multiplexing - Orthogonal Chirp Division Multiplexing, the goal of determining signal-code structures that provide the best noise immunity in Waterson, Rayleigh, and underwater channels. The main purpose of research is to find out the data about Bit Error Rate for different cases of usage of popular types of noise immunity codes. All of these codes are used for reducing of the negative effects of various channels such as high rate of noise or fading etc. For every other channel the influence of these effects does vary. The results of the research would provide the information about the effectiveness of low-density-parity-check, polar and turbo product codes in different channels such as underwater, Rayleigh, Waterson.

articleTitle: “Being a Student Today” Features of Present-Day University Education and Problems of Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of present-day educational space and the student's image. What are the specifics and features of a present-day student and the process of studying at a technical university? What are the best pedagogical methods and approaches to training future engineers? Today's “super-complex” world wants us to rely on an open and flexible educational process without set goals and focus on a specific model, with openness being much more important than stopping or incompleteness. The first part of the article focuses on the features of present-day knowledge, the educational process and the learner whose identification as a “student” is a real problem. The second part relates to methods and approaches for training future engineers. The present-day higher education has a tendency to get rid of the concept of a student educated by the teacher whose main function was to transfer certain traditions. The center of gravity in the educational process is transferred to the student, and the teacher's activities are significantly complicated.

Author Keywords: learner in all spheres of life

articleTitle: Increasing of Determining Route Altitude Accuracy in Difficultly Accessible Regions Using Aerospace Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: A multifactorial methodology has been proposed that allows you to develop precisely constructed routes and solve specific problems, including taking into account weather conditions, terrain, etc. The experience gained during initial measurements showed that in difficult weather conditions it is very important to quickly, in real time, receive information about the situation on the ground. This will make it possible to make operational decisions on the use of equipment in work area. Advantage of the presented solution is also its autonomy. The obtained data were experimentally verified and compared. A methodology has been developed to achieve the goal set in the work, equipment has been selected for its implementation, and possibility of nodes interfacing used at software and hardware level has been shown. The technology proposed in this work for constructing and detailing routes can be used to more effectively represent the geographical features of a real area and, in particular, for the deployment of communication nodes taking into relief account, as well as in projects when creating various models.

articleTitle: OFDM Signal Synchronous Reception Quality Analysis Under the Timing Synchronization Tracking Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article considers the effect of time synchronization tracking performance on the non-orthogonality of OFDM signals. It is shown that the tracking performance of system timing synchronization take effect to forming the additional distortions associated with change of integration period in processing channels OFDM receiver. The qualitative characteristics of receiving OFDM signals during the formation non-orthogonality distortions in processing channels under tracking performance of system timing synchronization are evaluated

articleTitle: Research of Static Application Security Testing Technique Problems and Methods for Solving Them
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the main aspects of static application security testing (SAST) technique. The aim of the work is to study the problems of storing and managing SAST results in the life cycle of secure software development and to find ways of solving them. The subject of the study is software being developed, the safety of which is verified using SAST. The relevance of the study is due to the fact that insufficient management of SAST data can seriously threaten the security, quality and confidentiality of data, as well as slow down the development process. The article provides experimental data on the use of a number of SAST results management systems. This study examines SAST results management systems such as SonarQube, Coverity and Fortify, because of their widespread use due to their wide functionality. The methodological basis of the article is the method of system analysis, a descriptive method, methods of theoretical analysis, as well as a generalization method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Solving the Problem of Load Balancing in Data Transmission Networks Using the Stepping Stone Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the effectiveness of using the SS method in combination with load balancing techniques to optimize the process of information transfer between applications based on the seven-level OSI (Open System Interconnection) model. The key stages of the process are considered, including the creation of a database of participants, the definition of a data transmission scheme, modeling of load distribution and an algorithm for minimizing the objective function. To minimize the objective function, a method for solving the transport problem in the framework of linear programming based on the SS (Stepping Stone) method and the formation of an initial reference plan using the northwest corner method is proposed. The work considers two load balancing scenarios, paying attention to explicit and interval values of quality parameters, which is a fuzzy task. An example of a solution for the specified parameters is provided, and a final algorithm is formulated that can effectively solve balanced data transmission problems in information systems.

articleTitle: Development of a Model of Distributed Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The universal popularity of distributed systems is due to the increasing number of devices interacting with each other. A distributed system can be represented as a graph, and its functioning is described as a set of processes in this graph. In this paper, a model of using a cylindrical coordinate system to represent the system is proposed. The abscissa of one plane will simultaneously be the ordinate of the other plane. For unambiguous identification, the corresponding quarter number is added to the attributes of the process or event. In the next step, the cylindrical system is combined with the Cartesian one. This approach will allow us to separately consider two or more absolutely identical processes with matching events.

articleTitle: A Measurement Method and a Mathematical Model of the Human Vision System's Temporal Peripheral Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: New wide field-of-view content displays require understanding how the human visual system perceives temporal frequency in peripheral areas. Human visual models have proven successful in describing temporal coding in central human vision. However, the question of how the visual regions of the human brain process temporal information in peripheral areas has received much less attention. A significant problem in developing new wide field-of-view content displays is the lack of knowledge about the perception of temporal frequency in peripheral areas by the human visual system. This work creates a new method of measuring thresholds of the visibility of temporal frequency in peripheral areas using different temporal modulation rates. A new mathematical model of the human vision's temporal peripheral characteristics is presented. This new data opens up opportunities for improving the work of video codecs and makes it possible to consider the perception of the temporal parameters by the human visual system in peripheral areas.

articleTitle: Investigation of the OCDM-OChDM Modulation Noise Immunity in Underwater Channels
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: The article discusses the possibility of using cascade multiple access Orthogonal Code Division Multiplexing - Orthogonal Chirp Division Multiplexing to ensure better noise immunity of information in channels with a high level of absorption, scattering, fading, etc., such as the wireless underwater channel. The aim of the research also is estimating the comparative computational complexity of the signal propagation of both types of compared communication and information transmission systems based on cascade multiple access. The experiment includes researching of the number of channels with various rate of negative effects, specifically underwater optical and acoustic channels. All of the data obtained during the experiment belongs to them. Besides, the results of research demonstrate dependence of bit error rate on the signal-to-noise ratio

articleTitle: The Use of Multi-Spectral Images Integration in On-Board Helicopter Information Support Systems During Search and Rescue Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 Systems of Signals Generating and Processing in the Field of on Board Communications
abstract: In order to ensure flight safety during search and rescue operations in difficult meteorological conditions, for example, in the Arctic zone, to generate messages and signals about an approaching obstacle, for the purpose of information support for the crew, it is necessary to provide visualization of the behind-the-cockpit environment by integration of the environment images obtained by cameras in different spectral ranges. The integral indicator of image quality is applicable to assess the information content of both the entire image and its individual parts of interest, obtained automatically or selected by the operator. It is advisable to use this indicator to assess the information content of the channels of technical vision systems for the purpose of adaptive adjustment of video image integration algorithms, in particular, as part of the hardware and software complex for search and rescue operations in difficult meteorological conditions. The implementation of the image integration procedure with subsequent visualization requires the presence of hardware, video cameras, television, long-wave and short-wave infrared ranges. It should be noted that each range requires certain shooting conditions, and, accordingly, is characterized by a given quality of the resulting images. The article shows the advantages and disadvantages of using cameras in the indicated spectral ranges, presents the results of their practical use, describes the procedure for image integration, and provides parameters for assessing their quality. It should be said that today, a very relevant area of research is the synthesis of complexes for supporting air search and res-cue operations with modules and hardware and software that implement procedures for ensuring the integration of initial data, which are often formed by a laser television module (LTM), including television video cameras (TV), long-wave infrared cameras (LWIR), short-wave infrared cameras (SWIR), laser-ranging module and forward view radar.
